goal: From the first ten recent arXiv cs.AI papers, find up to three about language models, reasoning, on-device inference or neural architectures, and summarize their main contributions.

read.script: const dl = document.querySelector('#articles, dl'); if (!dl) throw new Error('Articles list element not found'); const dts = Array.from(dl.querySelectorAll('dt')).slice(0, 10); const dds = Array.from(dl.querySelectorAll('dd')).slice(0, 10); if (dts.length === 0) throw new Error('No submissions found on the page'); return dts.map((dt, i) => { const dd = dds[i]; const absLink = dt.querySelector('a[title="Abstract"], a[href*="/abs/"]'); const pdfLink = dt.querySelector('a[title="Download PDF"], a[href*="/pdf/"]'); const titleEl = dd ? dd.querySelector('.list-title') : null; const authorsEl = dd ? dd.querySelector('.list-authors') : null; const paperId = absLink ? absLink.textContent.trim() : ''; const title = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.replace(/^Title:\s*/i, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''; const authors = authorsEl ? authorsEl.textContent.replace(/^Authors:\s*/i, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''; const absUrl = absLink ? absLink.href : ''; const pdfUrl = pdfLink ? pdfLink.href : ''; return { id: i, paperId, title, authors, absUrl, pdfUrl }; });

task.instruction: Select up to 3 papers about language models, reasoning, on-device inference, or neural architectures.

read.script: const absEl = document.querySelector('blockquote.abstract'); if (!absEl) throw new Error('Abstract blockquote not found'); return absEl.textContent.replace(/^\s*Abstract:\s*/i, '').trim();

task.instruction: Summarize the main contribution in one or two sentences grounded only in the provided abstract.

read.script: return { paperId: input.paper.paperId, title: input.paper.title, authors: input.paper.authors, abstractUrl: input.paper.absUrl, pdfUrl: input.paper.pdfUrl, abstract: input.abstract, summary: input.summary };

return { scope: 'At most the first 10 papers in page order from recent arXiv cs.AI submissions (https://arxiv.org/list/cs.AI/recent)', inspectedCount: input.extractedPapers.length, selectedCount: input.selectedPapers.length, summarizedCount: input.summarizedPapers.length, successfulSummaryCount: input.summarizedPapers.length, papers: input.summarizedPapers };

title: Select and Summarize Recent arXiv cs.AI Papers
